senses.gloss: m. pl. (fr. סיקוסיס, σύκωσις, v. also Gr. Dict. s. vv. σῦκον a. συκῆ) excrescences (on trees), lumps.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 41:1">Gen. R. s. 41</cite>, beg. (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 92:13">Ps. XCII, 13</cite>) <he>מה התמרה … לא עומקין ולא ס׳</he> Ar. (‘Rashi’ <he>פקיסין</he>, Var. <he>ס׳</he>; ed. <he>עקומין</he> for <he>עומקין</he>) as the palm and the cedar have neither cavities (curves) nor excrescences, so the righteous have not (in their character) either &c.; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 845:2">Yalk. Ps. 845</cite> <cite ref="O00407"><he>סוּקְיוֹסִין</he></cite>.
